_help.max_height: Stream height in pixels (480-3000). Lower = less lag and less phone load. ~1000-1400 matches a laptop screen.
_help.max_fps: Frame rate cap (5-120). 60 matches most monitors.
_help.bitrate_usb: Video quality multiplier over USB (0.1-3). 1.0 = about 0.08 bits per pixel per frame.
_help.bitrate_wifi: Same, over Wi-Fi. Lower it if Wi-Fi stutters.
_help.max_queued_frames_usb: How many frames may be in flight before the phone skips frames to stay current. Lower = less lag, more skipping.
_help.max_queued_frames_wifi: Same, over Wi-Fi (needs a bit more slack for Wi-Fi hiccups).
_help.keyframe_interval_s: Seconds between full refresh frames (1-10). Lower heals glitches faster but uses more data.
_help.jpeg_max_fps: Frame-rate cap while the MirrorLink app is in the background (JPEG mode, CPU-encoded), 5-60. Older iPhones may run lower.
_help.jpeg_quality: JPEG quality in background mode (0.2-0.95). Lower = smoother on slow links.
_help.orientation_map: Only if landscape shows sideways: map the phone's orientation value (shown in F1 stats) to degrees, e.g. {"6": 270}. Ctrl+R also rotates by hand.
